meta.title: Malaab — Find your team. Join the game.
meta.description: Find pickup football matches, missing players, opponents, venues and tournaments in your city.

footer.tagline: A community for recreational football — starting in Mosul.

hero.subtitle: Short of players or missing an opponent? Discover open matches near you, fill your roster, book a pitch and play.

upcoming.title: Matches looking for players
upcoming.subtitle: Live listings from organizers in your city.
upcoming.emptyBody: Be the first: create a match and players will find you.

find.title: Find
find.body: Filter matches by area, time, format, level and price — or post what you need.

join.title: Join
join.body: Reserve a spot instantly. If it's full, join the waiting list and get promoted automatically.

play.title: Play
play.body: Chat with your team, share costs transparently, and rate the experience afterwards.

teams.title: Teams
teams.body: Build a squad, recruit missing positions and challenge other teams.

venues.title: Venues
venues.body: Find pitches, compare prices and request bookings where venues support it.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.body: Register your team, follow fixtures, results and standings.

community.title: Built for real games
community.missing: Missing two players an hour before kickoff? Post the slots and fill them.
community.opponents: Teams publish opponent requests and accept challenges in one place.
community.organize: Organizers manage rosters, waiting lists and attendance without endless group chats.
community.cost: Pitch costs are split transparently — everyone sees the share before joining.

trust.title: Trust & safety
trust.privacy: Your exact location and contact details are never shown publicly.
trust.verified: Venues are verified by our team before they can take bookings.
trust.reviews: Reviews only come from people who actually played together.
trust.report: Report and block tools are available on every profile, listing and message.
trust.payments: No online payments yet — costs are settled in person and nothing is charged through the app.

onboarding.description: This helps us show relevant matches. Only your display name, city and the details you choose are public.
